divergences.upstreamResult: Upstream ranks matches by physically relocating item nodes and drops nested aria-activedescendant wiring from inside its layout-effect flush.
divergences.octaneResult: The binding expresses ranking with CSS order and keeps aria-activedescendant wired while preserving the observed selection and filtering behavior.
divergences.rationale: Renderer-owned DOM cannot be moved across compiled range markers, and the port batcher keeps nested selection work that upstream discards.
divergences.consumerImpact: DOM-order selectors can differ from visual order while filtering, and assistive tech sees aria-activedescendant earlier than on upstream.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Rely on cmdk state and accessibility attributes rather than nth-child selectors; do not assume aria-activedescendant is absent until a user-driven selection.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review if Octane gains safe renderer-owned node relocation or changes layout-effect batching.

divergences.upstreamResult: The pinned selector cannot resolve groups by id, so group sorting is effectively inactive.
divergences.octaneResult: Groups resolve by their registered value and reorder by their best matching item score.
divergences.rationale: The binding corrects a dead upstream lookup while retaining the same filtered item set.
divergences.consumerImpact: Multiple visible groups may appear in score order rather than source order.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Do not depend on the pinned upstream's ineffective group-sorting bug.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review when upstream changes its group lookup or sorting behavior.

divergences.upstreamResult: Upstream skips registration for forceMount items, so filtered.count stays 0 and Command.Empty can render over a visible force-mounted item; unmount also leaves no force-mount count to restore Empty afterward.
divergences.octaneResult: The port tracks forceMountedCount separately, suppresses Empty while any force-mounted item is visible, and releases that count on unmount so Empty can return.
divergences.rationale: Empty and a visible item are mutually exclusive; force-mounted items are exempt from filtering but still occupy the list.
divergences.consumerImpact: Menus that force-mount items while searching no longer show a contradictory "no results" empty state, and Empty returns once those items unmount.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Rely on Empty only when nothing is visible, including force-mounted items; do not assume upstream Empty/forceMount overlap.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review if upstream starts counting force-mounted items toward Empty.

divergences.upstreamResult: The pinned cmdk build leaves a zero-scoring force-mounted item first in DOM order for a mid-list forceMount while matches are filtered.
divergences.octaneResult: Because ranking uses CSS order, every valid item including force-mounted non-matches receives an order so zero-scorers stay below matches instead of keeping the default order 0.
divergences.rationale: An unranked flex child keeps order 0 and would otherwise paint ahead of every ranked match; the port ranks all valid items so force-mounted non-matches stay below scored matches.
divergences.consumerImpact: Force-mounted non-matches remain below scored matches while a filter is active, matching upstream append order.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Do not assume an unranked force-mounted item retains source-order priority during an active search.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review if ranking moves off CSS order or forceMount scoring changes.

divergences.upstreamResult: A throwing onValueChange reached from the layout-effect flush rethrows out of that flush.
divergences.octaneResult: The same throw is reported through console.error and the menu stays usable afterward (the search filter result remains).
divergences.rationale: Octane reports effect exceptions without failing the surrounding consumer-visible update path the case drives.
divergences.consumerImpact: A throwing onValueChange is visible in the console on Octane without aborting the search update the user just typed.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Handle onValueChange errors in user code; do not rely on one throw aborting or preserving private flush siblings.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review if Octane changes effect-exception reporting.

divergences.upstreamResult: Duplicate item values are silent; both options can render aria-selected.
divergences.octaneResult: Development builds warn when two live items share a value.
divergences.rationale: Selection is value-keyed, so duplicates produce an invalid single-select listbox; the runtime cannot pick a winner.
divergences.consumerImpact: Authors see a development warning for colliding item values.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Keep item values unique within a Command.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review if upstream adds equivalent duplicate-value diagnostics.

divergences.upstreamResult: Removing the selected force-mounted item leaves the selected value pointing at a removed node because forceMount items are never registered.
divergences.octaneResult: Force-mount teardown reselects like the plain item path, so aria-selected and aria-activedescendant move to a live item.
divergences.rationale: A selectable force-mounted item must release selection when it leaves the tree.
divergences.consumerImpact: Removing a selected force-mounted item no longer strands keyboard activation on a missing node.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Expect selection to move when a selected force-mounted item unmounts.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review if upstream registers and tears down forceMount items.

divergences.upstreamResult: Re-registering an item value during a search re-sorts but leaves filtered.count/groups stale, so Empty can remain over a newly matching item.
divergences.octaneResult: Value re-registration refreshes the whole filter aggregate, so Empty and group visibility match the new scores.
divergences.rationale: Upstream item registration already re-derives the aggregate; the value-change path should too.
divergences.consumerImpact: Changing an item value under an active search no longer shows Empty beside a visible match.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Expect Empty and group hidden state to track live scores when item values change.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review if upstream refreshes filtered aggregates on value change.

divergences.upstreamResult: asChild merges the cmdk item host into the child element.
divergences.octaneResult: Components always render their own host element; asChild has no Slot sink.
divergences.rationale: SlottableWithNestedChildren clones React elements; Octane compiled children are opaque.
divergences.consumerImpact: asChild cannot replace the cmdk host element on Octane.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Wrap cmdk hosts instead of using asChild, or style the host element directly.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review if Octane gains a faithful Slot/asChild equivalent.

divergences.upstreamResult: Command.Dialog only forwards open/onOpenChange, so defaultOpen never reaches Radix Root.
divergences.rationale: Uncontrolled open state is part of the Radix Dialog surface consumers expect.
divergences.consumerImpact: defaultOpen can show the menu without controlled open state on Octane.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Use controlled open on upstream cmdk; Octane may also use defaultOpen.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review if upstream starts forwarding defaultOpen.

divergences.upstreamResult: Upstream Empty keys only off filtered.count, which is 0 during SSR because items register in layout effects, so server HTML ships "no results" above a full list.
divergences.octaneResult: Empty uses a server snapshot of false, so SSR markup omits cmdk-empty until the client has a real count.
divergences.rationale: Item registration cannot run on the server; claiming empty there permanently misleads readers without JavaScript.
divergences.consumerImpact: Server-rendered menus no longer show a false empty state over populated items.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Expect Empty to appear only after client registration; do not assert cmdk-empty in SSR HTML.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review if Octane gains a server-side item registration path.
